# PokeInt

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Banks](BlitzBasic-Banks)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PokeInt:Void bank:Int32, offset:Int32, value:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to write to. |
| `offset` | In | Int32 | required | Position in bytes. |
| `value` | In | Int32 | required | The integer to store. |

## Description

Writes an integer in 4 bytes, low byte first.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
bank = CreateBank(4)
PokeInt bank, 0, $01020304
Print PeekByte(bank, 0)
Print PeekByte(bank, 3)
FreeBank bank
```

```text
4
1
```
